articles.title: Retail is Thriving in the Micro-fulfillment On-Demand Delivery Era
articles.subtitle: Images
articles.body: Have you noticed your online shopping orders arriving faster than ever? Brands are completely rewiring how they get products to you. Instead of shipping from massive warehouses across the country, they are using your local retail stores as mini-warehouses. It’s a massive win-win-win: faster delivery for you, better inventory turnover for the brand, and more opportunities for local drivers.Danielle Savino with Fractional CRO LLC latest blog breaks down exactly how giants like Target, Walmart, and H&M are pulling this off—and most importantly how local businesses can use the exact same strategies to scale their own growth.  Drop a comment below: What's the fastest delivery you've ever experienced from a clothing or tech brand? Read the full breakdown here: https://www.fractionalcro.org/post/retail-is-thriving-in-the-on-demand-delivery-era

articles.title: Sgt. Clean Car Wash Scholarship
articles.subtitle: Check out this great opportunity for graduating students!
articles.body:
Sgt. Clean Car Wash is recognizing 8 students, with 4 being internal team members, with a $1,000 scholarship. This scholarship awards eight (8) one-time scholarships of $1,000 each to qualifying students in Medina, Portage, Cuyahoga, Stark, or Summit County to be applied toward school tuition and fees in support of vocational trades, business, and or entrepreneurship.
How to Apply & Deadline: Submit an essay no longer than 300 words answering, “What does servant leadership mean to you? How will you show servant leadership in your life?” Submissions must be completed online at Sgtclean.com/scholarship by April 30, 2026.
Awards and Disbursement: All winners will be notified by May 12, 2026. Winners will be invited to a group luncheon with our Senior Executive Team for a check presentation. Funds will then be disbursed directly to the educational institution in the student’s name. Winners will have the opportunity to ask leadership and business questions over lunch.
Criteria: Must be a citizen, national, or legal permanent resident of the U.S. Must be a current (or recently graduated) high school senior planning to enroll full-time at an accredited U.S. vocational, junior college, or four-year college/university. Completed online application in full, submitted by the deadline.
